design: Paired original/single-sample/corrected renders at identical saved states and targets. These are offline fixed-state diagnostics, not new teacher rollouts.
estimator_truth_isolation: Every frame remeasured using FrozenCalibration with model/data/target truth APIs forbidden.

training_observation_audit.method: Every valid stored OCT vector with an independently resolved target minus FK truth. Merge offsets and exact terminal audits take precedence over raw ancestry. Unresolved targets are explicitly skipped. State stored as float32 deg/deg/mm; reconstruction precision is finite. No images regenerated or frozen data changed.
training_observation_audit.action_label_scope: Stored OCT observation bias is audited; action-label corruption is not inferred solely from observation bias.

attribution.mask: RGB mask selects visible sphere surface samples; the estimator already fits the calibrated sphere center rather than using surface depth as center. Earlier erosion ablations did not remove the main bias.
attribution.sampling: Compare original vs single_sample: same sphere mesh/intrinsics/extrinsics and estimator, changed offscreen MSAA only. Depth resolve and RGB coverage are incompatible with the assumed single pixel-center ray at subpixel precision.
attribution.tessellation: Compare single_sample vs corrected: changed only render sphere tessellation, reducing deviation from the calibrated ideal sphere.
attribution.calibration: Same camera pose, fovy, pixel-center convention and .15mm sphere radius throughout; no fitted truth offset or access to dynamic truth in estimation.
attribution.scope: Deterministic simulation bias across four saved steady poses per target; repeated deterministic frames do not estimate real sensor random noise. This is an empirical diagnostic, not a theoretical perception limit.
attribution.gate2b: Not run here; requires a passed and closed Gate1 execution protocol.
